sections.title: Asset Bay
sections.intro: 3D assets, Blender add-ons, shaders and brushes for artists and creators. Pay by UPI, get the files by email.

payment.deliveryNote: Your download link arrives by email once the payment is checked.

items.title: Character Concept Art Brushes
items.pitch: Photoshop brushes for character and environment concept art.
items.includes: Photoshop brush pack for character and environment concept art (31 brushes used in the showcase)
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description:
The showcase painting (3840×2160) was built with 31 brushes from this pack: 17 character brushes, the ogre hide and cracked leather skins, and 12 environment and effects brushes. It shows an ogre warlord, a swordsman and his cloaked companion on an ember-lit crag, with goblin squads, a drake and a tentacled horror in the misty mountains behind.

The breakdown strip shows the five stages from silhouette to final, and which brushes went into each one.

items.title: Brussy Concept Brushes
items.pitch: 30 procedural Photoshop brushes for concept art — rock, organic, foliage, sci-fi, FX and painterly tips.
items.includes: Brussy_Concept_Brushes.abr (30 named brushes) + PNG tip fallbacks + preview sheet
items.compatibility: Adobe Photoshop (also usable as PNG tips in Krita / GIMP / Procreate)
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Every tip was generated from code (noise, Voronoi, reaction-diffusion, IFS fractals, space-colonisation roots, curl-noise flow) — no photos or downloaded images. Tips are 8-bit grayscale, 320–1024 px, with soft falloff. Groups cover rock & texture, organic, foliage, sci-fi / industrial, FX, fantasy, environment and painterly strokes.

items.title: Brussy Skin Texture Brushes
items.pitch: 50 Photoshop brushes for skin detail — pores, freckles, age spots, blemishes and surface texture.
items.includes: Brussy_Skin_Texture_Brushes.zip with .abr pack and PNG tips
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: A 50-brush Photoshop set focused on skin surface detail for character painting. Built as a companion to the Brussy concept and line-art packs.

items.title: Brussy Line Art Brushes
items.pitch: 50 Photoshop brushes for clean and expressive line art, inking and contour work.
items.includes: Brussy_LineArt_Brushes.zip with .abr pack and PNG tips
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Fifty line-art brushes for Photoshop, from clean contour inkers to textured edge breaks. The showcase painting was built with this pack.

items.title: Brussy Character Kit
items.pitch: 30 Procreate brushes for character work — ink, skin, pores, freckles, scars and form shading.
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: A Procreate brush set for character artists: contour inkers, calligraphic pens, graphite scaffolding, skin airbrush and glazes, pore fields, freckles, peach-fuzz, scars, wet-skin mixer and undertone clouds. Install by opening the .brushset in Procreate.

items.title: PaintStroke v2
items.pitch: Turn any mesh into an oil, gouache, watercolour or impressionist painting — Lite and HQ node groups.
items.includes: PaintStroke_asset.blend (Lite + HQ node groups, 5 Lite + 5 HQ materials) + demo scene + blender_assets.cats.txt
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: PaintStroke turns any mesh into a painted look. v2 keeps the same four presets and look, but is rebuilt so Blender stops freezing while the shader compiles. Lite is for viewport scrubbing and GPUs ≤ 6 GB; HQ is for final stills with triplanar wrapping and optional Edge Breakup. Use View Transform = Standard for punchy painted colour.

items.title: InkVerse v1.1
items.pitch: Procedural comic-book / graphic-novel shader — cel shading, halftone, hatching, print offset and ink outlines.
items.includes: InkVerse_asset.blend (shader + 5 presets, Speed Lines GN, Outline Hull GN) + demo scene
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: InkVerse gives any mesh a comic-print look: cel tones, Ben-Day / screentone dots, hatching, CMY plate offset, paper grain and ink outlines. Presets include Bold, Classic Comic, Manga, Pop Art and Newspaper. v1.1 adds punchier Bold colours, clearer halftones, full-surface CMY offset, velocity-based speed lines (off by default) and an inverted-hull outline Geometry Nodes asset.

items.title: IrisFoil v1
items.pitch: Holographic and iridescent materials — thin-film, diffraction, soap bubble, beetle shell, holo sticker and more.
items.includes: IrisFoil_asset.blend (IrisFoil node group + 8 materials) + product-shot demo scene
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Procedural thin-film and diffraction materials for product ads, merch, packaging and stylized work. Looks include Holo Foil, Soap Bubble, Beetle Shell, Holo Sticker, Pearlescent Car Paint, Oil Slick and Opal. Procedural spectral colour works in Eevee and Cycles; Principled Thin Film Thickness drives the Cycles path.

items.title: Reaction v1
items.pitch: Surfaces that remember contact — dents, heat, cracks, dust rings and wear driven by Geometry Nodes simulation.
items.includes: Reaction_asset.blend (Reactor GN + ReactionSurface group + 5 preset materials) + demo scenes
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Move an object into a surface and the surface remembers the hit: pressure discoloration, a displaced dent, blackbody heat that cools down, radial cracks, a dust ring, glow, wear, fingerprints and melting. A Geometry Nodes simulation does the physics; a layered shader draws the result on top of any base material. Bake the simulation for final renders.

items.title: Meshy Tools 1.4.1
items.pitch: Tris→quads retopology, region retopo, UVs and Substance-style mesh-map baking in one sidebar tab.
items.includes: meshy_tools zip (Blender Extension + legacy add-on) with Region Retopo, Feature Edge Guided retopo, UV unwrap and baking
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Meshy Tools combines automatic quad retopology (feature-edge-guided crease preservation, curvature-adaptive density, character / hard-surface / game / scan presets), Region Retopo for selected high-poly faces, automatic UV unwrapping, and Substance-style mesh-map baking (Normal, AO, Cavity, Curvature, Object Normal, Position; PNG or OpenEXR). Retopology runs in a background Blender process so the UI stays responsive.

items.title: Heat Weight Doctor 1.0.3
items.pitch: Diagnose and fix “Bone Heat Weighting: failed to find solution for one or more bones”.
items.includes: heat_weight_doctor zip (Diagnose, Fix All Safe, Proxy Heat, Auto Weights Safe)
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Standalone add-on for the classic Automatic Weights failure. Diagnose lists each issue with a plain-English Why, then Fix All Safe, Scale-Up Weight, Proxy Heat or Envelope Fallback. One-click Auto Weights (Safe) runs the safe cleanup path end to end. Checks cover scale, duplicates, non-manifold edges, holes, flipped normals, intersecting shells (eyes/teeth/clothes) and more.

items.title: Jelly Character Toolkit v3
items.pitch: One-click modeling, weight paint, rigging, body types, hair & clothes helpers for character artists.
items.includes: jelly_character_toolkit zip — Modeling, Weight Paint, Rigging, Shape Keys, Body Types, Hair/Clothes Rigs, Export/Pack
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Jelly Character Toolkit speeds up character pack work: modeling helpers, weight painting, rigging, body-slider shape keys and Lite/Deluxe packaging. v2/v3 add ready-made body types, regional proportions, gravity hair rigs, clothes rigs and cleanup tools. Panel: 3D View → N → Jelly.

items.title: Cute Wardrobe v2.1
items.pitch: 10 women’s apparel pieces that measure and fit themselves to any adult female body — any pose.
items.includes: cute_wardrobe_v2.1.0.zip — 10 garments/accessories with 2K fabric maps and live style controls
items.compatibility: Blender 4.5 LTS up to newest (tested 4.5.15 LTS and 5.2.3)
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Cute Wardrobe builds satin cami, blouse, wrap dress, jeans, pleated skirt, cardigan, thigh-highs, choker, shoulder bag and beret. Each piece measures the body, fits in any pose, UV-unwraps, textures and rigs in one step. Works on petite through plus-size, realistic or anime-style, at any scale. Panel: N → Wardrobe.

items.title: Weight Paint Pro 1.0.0
items.pitch: Fast per-bone weight painting — paint through, mirror, appendage mode and problem finder.
items.includes: weight_paint_pro zip — Bones list, Per-Bone Tools, Appendage, Paint Through, Mirror, Quality & Problems
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Paint one bone at a time, paint front and back together, mirror left/right, weight whole limbs with Appendage mode, and find bad weights quickly — without freezing the UI on 100k–300k vertex characters. Hotkeys for prev/next bone, isolate and paint-through. Panel: N → Weight Paint Pro.

items.title: Intelligent Auto-Weights + Deformation Analyzer
items.pitch: Score joint deformation with calibration poses, then optimize skin weights where it hurts.
items.includes: auto_weights_addon.zip — Analyze, Optimize, heatmap, mirror-symmetric joints
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Pick mesh + armature, detect joints (Rigify / Mixamo / UE / generic names), run calibration poses, and get a 0–100 deformation score per joint plus a heatmap. Optimize Weights searches blend profiles and smoothing that improve the score without hurting neighbours. Covers shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees and ankles. Panel: N → AutoWeights.

items.title: NeonDrip
items.pitch: Neon tube glow, flicker, LED screens and wet asphalt reflections for Blender.
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Procedural neon & cyberpunk signage materials — tube glow, flicker, emission bleed, LED screen and wet reflections. Still being polished before sale.

items.title: StageWalk
items.pitch: Play your character like a game in the Blender viewport and record clean takes as keyframes.
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: WASD + mouse locomotion with run, jump and crouch over your own set. Record on Play writes NLA takes. Currently a preview / Phase 1 build.

items.title: PuppetPose
items.pitch: Grab the character mesh to pose its humanoid FK controls — full-body IK with pins and planted feet.
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Fresh build for Blender 4.5+. Mesh-grab posing with a CPU full-body IK solver, pins, planted feet and floor collision. Barely tested — notify me when you want early access.

items.title: BeatForge 2.0.1
items.pitch: Beat-synced editing inside Adobe After Effects — stems, lyrics, smart pick and song-swap.
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Beat maps, live beat grid, stem-aware cuts, lyric auto-sync, energy FX and section-aware song-swap. Validated with mocks and analyzer runs; not yet tested inside a real After Effects install on the build machine.

items.title: AutoReframe
items.pitch: One master After Effects comp → editable 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 copies with a Needs Review report.
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Builds a separate editable copy for each delivery format, including 3D cameras and expression rewrite/wrap. Core logic passes automated mock checks; not yet run inside real After Effects.

items.title: CharacterSync
items.pitch: Photoshop ↔ Blender bridge — UXP plugin + Blender extension for local image transfer.
items.formats: Photoshop UXP plugin + Blender Extension (when packaged)
items.licence: Personal and commercial use for your own artwork
items.description: Step 1–2 connection and PNG transfer over a local WebSocket, with pairing codes and a beginner GUIDE. Not packaged for sale yet.
